snapshot.title: Marketplace panel: show market prices at Level 5
snapshot.description: Economy doc specifies Marketplace unlocks at Level 5. Shows live mineral market prices. Prices fluctuate based on supply (player selling drives price down). Allows players to time sales strategically.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Marketplace section added to game menu (or Earth base screen)
Marketplace is hidden/locked before Level 5 with 'Unlocks at L5' indicator
Prices shown for each mineral type
Selling minerals causes price to dip (simple supply effect per mineral)
